names.note: The calendar’s own name page for him is «Владимир (Джуринский), протоиерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Владимира пресвитера». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1920)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 9 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Владимира пресвитера и мц. Евфросинии (1920).»

attestations.note: The first of the two the day’s sixth line names, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGES ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind either of them. The line says «пресвитера» and the name page «протоиерей», archpriest, so `presbyter` is the line’s word and the office `Archpriest` the name page’s. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries. No folder held him: a Cyrillic grep for «Джуринск» over every `saint.json` returns nothing. The day page prints seven hymns and none is under either name.
